construction: Generated with pcaputil sessionTestPCAP, h2TestFrame, h2TestHeaders, dohExchangeH2GET/dohExchangeH2Response and ClickHouse Hello fixture helpers. TCP headers and application messages are synthetic; no deployed resolver/server capture is claimed. DoH captures contain plaintext HTTP carrier bytes and do not demonstrate TLS decryption.

files.description: Conventional ClickHouse client name with empty password, Hello+Ping coalesced, followed by server Hello+Pong. Both roles and all four messages are established.
Capture starts with a synthetic server Hello and coalesced Pong. Its bytes also form a client Hello with a one-byte password; role context is required.
Two pipelined HTTP/1.1 DoH GET exchanges both use DNS ID zero; responses must match one.example then two.example.
HTTP/2 stream 1 returns HTTP 415 text/plain with DATA body error; stream 3 then completes a valid DNS exchange.
Concurrent HTTP/2 streams 1 and 3 both use DNS ID zero; stream 3 responds before stream 1.
